role: Type definitions for expectation verification events in the Co-Being knowledge graph.
detail: Defines three frozen Pydantic models for the Epic 4 expectation verification pipeline. PredictionError records a single expectation violation when observed property value deviates >2.0 sigma from schema-level mean (D-TS-09); triggers PREDICTION_ERROR_DEMOTION EvolutionRule (CANON A.2) and confidence lowering. PredictionErrorDetectedEvent wraps PredictionError with session_id and correlation_id, emitted by verification function (T046), increments prediction_errors on PropertyExpectation node. PredictionSuccessEvent emitted when observation falls within expected range, increments confirmation_count via D-TS-10 formula (min(1.0, current + (1.0 - current) * 0.1)), tracks signed deviation_from_mean (negative=below mean, positive=above). All three models immutable (frozen=True) to enforce append-only semantics for event records.
